keywords: EIP-8250 keyed nonce 改收状态 gas
EIP-8272 recent roots 改用 VERIFY 帧
summary: frame 交易配套 EIP 当天密集更新：EIP-8250 把新建 keyed nonce 改为按 EIP-8037 一个新存储槽的价格（97,920）收状态 gas，EIP-8272 用规范的 VERIFY 帧取代 recent roots 交易字段。spencer-tb 提交 PR，想在 EIP-8037 安全考量里说明 `GAS` 在帧内不再单调。隐私方向，recmo 宣布 ProveKit v1，在手机上就能做零知识身份证明，dcbuilder 次日凌晨补充说它已用于 World ID。

items.topic: frame 交易的 gas 和验证规则
items.title: EIP-8250：keyed nonce 首次使用按状态 gas 收费
items.note: 合并（soispoke）。EIP-8141 给每个帧分开执行 gas 和状态 gas 预算，而 EIP-8250 原来从批准帧的执行 gas 收 20,000；改为从 `state_gas_left` 收取，价格按 EIP-8037 一个新存储槽 `STATE_BYTES_PER_STORAGE_SET * CPSB`（当前 97,920），因为每个新 key 都会新建一个普通持久槽。
items.title_en: EIP-8250: charge keyed nonce first use as state gas
items.note_en: Was merged (soispoke). EIP-8141 gives each frame separate execution and state gas budgets, while EIP-8250 still charged 20,000 from the approving frame's execution gas. The charge now comes from `state_gas_left`, priced at EIP-8037's cost for one new storage slot, `STATE_BYTES_PER_STORAGE_SET * CPSB` (currently 97,920), since each fresh key creates one ordinary persistent slot.

items.topic: frame 交易的 gas 和验证规则
items.title: EIP-8272：用规范 frame 验证 recent roots
items.note: （soispoke）。去掉 `recent_root_references` 字段，改为调用 recent root 合约的 `VERIFY` 帧，最多 16 个 `(source_id, slot, root)` 元组，放在应用验证之前；公共内存池验证只允许 `SLOTNUM` 和必要的 recent root 存储读取，该帧不计入 `MAX_VERIFY_GAS`，把预算留给签名检查。
items.title_en: EIP-8272: verify recent roots with a canonical frame
items.note_en: (soispoke). The `recent_root_references` field is replaced by a `VERIFY` frame that calls the recent root contract with up to sixteen `(source_id, slot, root)` tuples, placed before application validation. Public mempool validation allows only `SLOTNUM` and the required recent root storage reads, and the frame does not count toward `MAX_VERIFY_GAS`, leaving that budget for signature checks.

items.title: EIP-8037：说明 gas_left 可能在帧内增加
items.note: （spencer-tb），只加安全考量、不改语义，说明 `GAS` 不再单调；该 PR 最终被关闭未合并。
items.title_en: EIP-8037: note that gas_left can increase within a frame
items.note_en: (spencer-tb) added only a security consideration, without changing semantics, stating that `GAS` is no longer monotonic; the PR was eventually closed without merging.

keywords_en: EIP-8250 keyed nonces charged as state gas
EIP-8272 recent roots via a VERIFY frame
summary_en: The EIPs around frame transactions saw a burst of updates: EIP-8250 now charges a new keyed nonce as state gas at EIP-8037's price for one new storage slot (97,920), and EIP-8272 replaces the recent roots transaction field with a canonical VERIFY frame. spencer-tb filed a PR to state in EIP-8037's security considerations that `GAS` is no longer monotonic within a frame. On privacy, recmo announced ProveKit v1, bringing zero-knowledge identity proofs to phones; dcbuilder added shortly after midnight that it already powers World ID.
